messages:
ava_marketing: Quick thread  NovaPulse case study status. We have the interview transcript and signed release. Need final quote wording + legal thumbs-up by Fri so we can hit next-week publish.

ben_growth: I'll draft SEO headline options and short social lines tonight. Any hard do-not-publish items?

rita_cs: Customer asked to avoid mentioning specific cloud providers and removed any revenue numbers. They approved two short quotes; preferred attribution: 'K. Ramirez, Head of Data'. Signed PDF attached.

omar_pm: Benchmarks: steady-state throughput ~2.2x, p95 latency from 380ms -> 160ms. I'll prepare a one-paragraph methods note for the appendix.

nina_design: I can do a hero image + stat card. Which logo? Customer supplied horizontal and stacked, they prefer horizontal.

ava_marketing: Use horizontal. Also plan a pull quote: "Redwood made our inference predictable in production." Use exact quote only if customer signs off on the final phrasing.

legal_bot: Confirmed: redact internal hostnames and remove contract numbers. Keep quote verbatim as in signed release. Distribution: NA/EU ok; APAC requires extra consent which we do not have.

ben_growth: Draft social lines: 1) "NovaPulse scales real-time features with Redwood" 2) "Predictable inference at production scale for NovaPulse" 3) "How NovaPulse improved p95 latency by ~58%" Which is safest?

rita_cs: Option 2 aligns best with the approved quote. For stat calls, use the methods box with numbers rather than the main quote unless they explicitly approve percent language. I'll ping the customer to confirm permission for the p95 percent.

ovar_pm: (typo) oops meant omar_pm: I'll attach the sanitized benchmark CSV to the PR after redaction.

nina_design: Uploaded assets to `design/marketing/novapulse-v0.3.zip`. Left placeholder for the quote.

ava_marketing: Customer replied: approved the exact quote and gave permission to include the numeric latency values but asked to phrase throughput as "over twice the throughput". They want publish timing Wed 9am PT. Signed copy stored in the PR.

ben_growth: Updated headline options: A) "NovaPulse achieves predictable inference at production scale with Redwood" B) "How NovaPulse improved p95 latency from 380ms to 160ms" C) "NovaPulse sees over twice the throughput on Redwood Dedicated"

legal_bot: All clear to publish in NA/EU with the approved quote and sanitized assets. Ensure PR contains the signed release and the redaction checklist.

ava_marketing: Great. I'll open the PR now and tag reviewers. Internal review deadline Tue 4pm PT, publish Wed 9am PT. Thanks team :rocket: 

rita_cs: I'll monitor the customer for any last-minute copy tweaks.

nina_design: No blockers on design side. Will push final PNGs by EOD Tue.
